_comment: A7 item 19 / F-B04-5, the case unicode_label_collision.json misses: the SAME degenerate-label fallback, but with the node ids an editor actually produces. Imported and pasted nodes are re-keyed as `<timestamp>-<index>` (skald-ui/src/utils/importLayout.ts), which sanitizes to '1785492489424_0'. The exposed-parameter path emits '<label>_<param>' as a bare struct field, so a fallback that forces a leading digit through emits '1785492489424_0_amplitude' - not a legal Odin identifier, i.e. a hard compile failure where the old bug merely collided silently. The golden pins the 'n'-prefixed form, and the emitted file must pass `odin check`. Hand-authored ids like 'oscemoji' cannot catch this, which is why they didn't.
